description: Defines the ue_fallback_scheduler class responsible for scheduling grants for DL SRB0/SRB1 and UL SRB1 messages in fallback state within a 5G NR scheduler implementation.

classes.name: ue_fallback_scheduler
classes.description: Scheduler class for managing fallback state grant allocations for UEs in 5G NR.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_state_indication
methods.description: Handles DL buffer state reports for scheduling SRB0/SRB1.

methods.name: handle_ul_bsr_indication
methods.description: Handles UL buffer status report indications.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SRB0 DL grants for a given slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler when cell is deactivated.
